planExecution.completedWithTomorrowOne: Today's planned work is complete. Focus on fueling, mobility, and sleep now. You have one session tomorrow, so do not add more intensity today.
planExecution.completedWithTomorrowMany: Today's planned work is complete. Focus on fueling, mobility, and sleep now. You have {count} sessions tomorrow, so do not add more intensity today.
planExecution.completed: Today's planned work is complete. Focus on recovery, hydration, and sleep, and note how the session felt so I can use it in later adjustments.
planExecution.partial: You have completed {count} linked activity today. Decide on the remaining work from how your legs and overall fatigue feel; protect the quality of the work instead of forcing the volume.
planExecution.plannedOne: You have one planned session today. Start with the plan, check how you feel after the warm-up, and keep the effort within the target range. Link the activity afterward so I can keep adjusting your training.
planExecution.plannedMany: You have {count} planned sessions today. Start with the plan, check how you feel after the warm-up, and keep the effort within the target range. Link the activities afterward so I can keep adjusting your training.
planExecution.plannedNone: There is no specific session on the schedule today. Keep it to easy recovery or mobility work, and do not add a hard session just because you feel fresh.
planExecution.extraOne: There is one extra activity today. First check whether it belongs to a planned session. If it was extra training, reduce tomorrow's intensity or duration as needed.
planExecution.extraMany: There are {count} extra activities today. First check whether they belong to planned sessions. If they were extra training, reduce tomorrow's intensity or duration as needed.
planExecution.restWithTomorrowOne: Today is a rest day, so recover instead of making up volume. You have one session tomorrow; sleep early and replenish fluids and carbohydrates so you are ready for it.
planExecution.restWithTomorrowMany: Today is a rest day, so recover instead of making up volume. You have {count} sessions tomorrow; sleep early and replenish fluids and carbohydrates so you are ready for them.
planExecution.rest: Today is a rest day. Catch up on sleep, keep movement light, and note any soreness. You do not need an extra session just to preserve a streak.
planExecution.noPlan: You do not have an active training plan yet. Tell me your goal event, preparation window, and weekly availability, and I will help plan your next block.

decision.unavailable: I could not load your latest training update. Please refresh and try again. Until I can confirm the update, follow your current schedule.
decision.statePending: Your current state check is still missing one key detail. Until it is answered, do not chase the planned intensity; keep today conservative and recovery-focused.
decision.approved: This adjustment is confirmed. {detail}. Follow it while your schedule updates, and do not add another session.
decision.proposed: I have a new suggestion for you. {detail}. Confirm it and I will update your schedule.
decision.rejectedWorkout: I remember you chose not to use the last adjustment. Follow today's scheduled session, “{title}”, and ease off if your body needs it.
decision.rejectedRest: I remember you chose not to use the last adjustment. Keep today as the scheduled rest day and focus on recovery and how your body feels.
decision.guidance: {summary}. One more reminder from our last review: {guidance}.
decision.doNotRace: do not turn this session into a race

fact.influenceWindow: you are currently inside its influence window
fact.competition: You marked {event} as {importance}; {timing}{distanceNote}. I recommend protecting race preparation and recovery today, then deciding from how you feel whether to train as planned or reduce the load.
fact.noPlan: You do not have an active training plan yet. Tell me your goal, preparation window, and weekly availability, and I will help you decide how to train today.
fact.completedOne: Today's planned session is complete. Focus on fueling, mobility, and sleep for the rest of the day instead of adding intensity.
fact.completedMany: All {count} planned sessions are complete. Focus on fueling, mobility, and sleep for the rest of the day instead of adding intensity.
fact.activityWithDuration: There was no planned session today, but you recorded a {duration}-minute {sport}. There is no need to add make-up volume; focus on hydration, fueling, mobility, and recovery now.
fact.activityWithoutDuration: There was no planned session today, but you recorded a {sport}. There is no need to add make-up volume; focus on hydration, fueling, mobility, and recovery now.
fact.restFatigue: No workout is planned today and your form is low (TSB {tsb}). Prioritize recovery, avoid adding load, and protect sleep and fueling.
fact.restLoad: No workout is planned today. Weekly load is up {drift}, so keep this recovery window instead of adding extra volume.
fact.rest: No workout is planned today. Rest well, or keep any movement easy if you feel fresh.
fact.fatigue: The plan is “{title}”, but your form is low (TSB {tsb}). Keep the intensity controlled today and shorten the session if recovery feels limited.
fact.loadSpike: Today's focus is “{title}”. Weekly load is up {drift}, so complete the key work and avoid adding extra volume.
fact.multiWorkout: You have {count} planned sessions today. Complete the key session, “{title}”, first, then decide on the rest from how you feel.
fact.workout: Today's focus is “{title}”. Stay within the target effort and link the activity afterward so I can review it with you.
